messages:
remy: Quick sync 0 I'm splitting the rate limits + quotas doc into a compact reference and a migration playbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/923. Can someone check the JS SDK snippet and the dashboard link tokens?
olivia: Link looks good. JS snippet still uses `client.oldUsage.submit()`  needs `client.usage.report()` instead.
harper: Also remove raw grafana panel URLs; use `{{panel_link}}` tokens per ops guidance. I'll send the mapping to ops-infra.
remy: Good catch. I'll update the snippet and swap tokens. Thinking to include both legacy and new snippets with a small compatibility transform example.
olivia: Include a short 429 example and a backoff pattern for JS docs-tests:
```
for (let i=0;i<4;i++){
  const r = await client.usage.report(payload)
  if (r.status===429){
    await sleep((parseInt(r.headers['retry-after']||'1')*(2**i))*1000)
  } else break
}
```
harper: i18n note: mark the new headings with `_()` so the extractor picks them up.
remy: Added checklist in the PR description: update headers, payload field rename `token_count` -> `token_total`, add doctest, i18n extraction.
eng-docs-bot: CI queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/923  lint error: trailing space in example.
remy: Fixed and pushed.
olivia: Staging preview looks good, deprecated banner visible, tokens render to friendly links.
eng-docs-bot: staging deploy succeeded 0 https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/quotas-migration
remy: Thanks all. I'll merge after one more rubber stamp. Closing follow-ups after merge.
